parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can specify an asterisk (\*) as the value to match all applications that belong to the domain name.

parameters.name: Stream
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. You can use the wildcard (\*) to specify all streams of the application.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-delay-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain example.com --app liveApp0000 --stream liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveDelayConfig --region cn-hangzhou --App liveApp0000 --Stream liveStream0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'example.com'
